pictureRender.title: Render Picture
pictureRender.description: Create a PNG from the visible committed model. Picture settings are temporary and do not change your project.
pictureRender.qualityHint: Draft uses fast raster rendering. Standard and High progressively trace 24 and 64 samples. Larger pictures can take up to two minutes; try Draft if your GPU cannot finish.
pictureRender.finishesHint: Keep the model appearance or choose a finish for this picture. Body colours are preserved; wood adds procedural grain.
pictureRender.imageAlt: Rendered picture of the visible model

errors.unsupported-relief: Picture rendering does not support authored surface relief. Disable the Surface texture layers before rendering.
errors.unsupported-assembly: Picture rendering does not support assembly occurrence placement. Render a model without assembly instances.
errors.empty: Show at least one rebuilt model body to render a picture.
errors.stale: The project, revision or visible bodies changed. Render again to use the current model.
errors.limit: This picture exceeds the rendering limits: 128 bodies, 200,000 triangles, 32 MiB of mesh data or 12 MiB of PNG data. Reduce the model or image size.
errors.busy: Another picture is rendering. Wait for it or cancel it before trying again.
errors.timeout: Rendering exceeded two minutes. Choose Draft or a smaller image and try again.
errors.unavailable: Your browser could not start picture rendering. Enable graphics acceleration or try Draft at a smaller size.
errors.context-lost: The GPU stopped picture rendering. Try Draft or a smaller image.
errors.encoding: The browser could not encode the PNG. Try again with a smaller image.
errors.invalid-input: The model or camera cannot be rendered with these settings. Rebuild the model or choose auto-frame and retry.
errors.failed: Picture rendering failed. Try Draft or a smaller image.
